question: The number of diagonals of an n-sided regular polygon is 665. What is the value of ‘n’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use formula: diagonals = n(n − 3) ÷ 2

Given = 665 ⇒ n(n − 3) = 1330

Check nearby values ⇒ 38 × 35 = 1330

So n = 38

**∴ Answer = 38**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of diagonals = 665

**Formula used:**

Number of diagonals = n(n − 3) ÷ 2

**Calculation:**

⇒ n(n − 3) ÷ 2 = 665

⇒ n(n − 3) = 1330

⇒ n² − 3n − 1330 = 0

⇒ n² − 38n + 35n − 1330 = 0

⇒ n(n − 38) + 35(n − 38) = 0

⇒ (n + 35)(n − 38) = 0

⇒ n = 38 (positive value)

**∴ The correct answer is 38.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
